================================================================================
Immediate variable and parameter registers remain valid when adjacent
================================================================================
{v0,p1}
---
(program (register_list (register (variable)) (register (parameter))))

================================================================================
Immediate parameter and variable registers remain valid when adjacent
================================================================================
{p2,v3}
---
(program (register_list (register (parameter)) (register (variable))))

================================================================================
Register-shaped spelling is a whole word outside instruction syntax
================================================================================
v012
---
(program (identifier))

================================================================================
Parameter-shaped spelling is a whole word outside instruction syntax
================================================================================
p123
---
(program (identifier))

================================================================================
Whitespace cannot authorize an immediate register
:error
================================================================================
move v0,p1
---
(ERROR (ERROR (identifier)) (register (parameter)))

================================================================================
Whitespace after a comma cannot authorize an immediate register
:error
================================================================================
movev0, p1
---
(program (ERROR (identifier)) (identifier))

================================================================================
A newline cannot authorize an immediate register
:error
================================================================================
move
v0,p1
---
(ERROR (ERROR (identifier)) (register (parameter)))

================================================================================
A register suffix cannot split a longer opcode-shaped word
:error
================================================================================
movev0,p1
---
(program (identifier) (ERROR (parameter)))
